lesson_title: Generative AI, models, and deployment choices
learner_starting_state: Can identify generative AI as a workload but may treat model, deployment, and generation parameters as interchangeable.
learner_ending_state: Can explain probabilistic token generation and choose an appropriate model capability, deployment pattern, data-processing scope, or generation parameter for a beginner scenario.
mastery_gate: Score 16 of 16 on both primary and fresh-transfer forms, cover model mechanics, model choice, deployment choice, and configuration, then explain one decision without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: Exam scope and current Foundry behavior trace to official Microsoft sources; scenarios, reasons, and strict coaching gates are course-authored.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify model availability, supported parameters, deployment SKUs, regions, quotas, and preview status before live implementation.

notes: Two-form model-to-deployment decision lab; does not require live Azure access.
